abstract: INTRODUCTION: We report that the coincidence of ovarian tumor and pregnancy poses significant challenges that are more pronounced if the pregnancy is ectopic. CASE PRESENTATION: Here, we report a rare and interesting case of a 24-year-old nulliparous Spanish woman who experienced the coincidental occurrence of left tubal pregnancy and dysgerminoma in the right ovary. The corpus luteum settled in the right ovary. A right adnexectomy and left linear salpingostomy were performed. Remarkably, our patient became pregnant spontaneously after surgery. The pregnancy occurred prior to starting chemotherapy, and the intra-uterine pregnancy was carried to term; later, she also had another normal pregnancy. Our patient has done well without chemotherapy. CONCLUSIONS: Our report on the challenges of diagnosis and treatment faced in this case can help clinicians better understand and manage these pathologies. We have not found any similar cases in the literature.
abstract_ja: 序論：卵巣腫瘍と妊娠が併存すると、特に子宮外妊娠の場合には重大な診断・治療上の課題が生じる。症例提示：24歳の未経産スペイン人女性が、左卵管妊娠と右卵巣のディスジャーミノーマの同時発生を経験した。黄体は右卵巣に存在した。右付属器摘出術と左卵管線状切開術を施行した。術後、本患者は化学療法開始前に自然妊娠し、子宮内妊娠は満期まで継続して出産に至った。その後も正常な妊娠を経験した。化学療法を行わなくても良好な経過をたどっている。結論：本報告は、この病態の診断および治療に伴う課題を示すものであり、臨床医の理解と管理に役立つと考えられる。本症例に類似した報告は文献上見当たらなかった。
